'''D5-F2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and, later, [[Crag Outpost]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D5-F2 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Imperial mission courier for Oricon, a Daily Area added in Game Update 2.4<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
